reviews.title: Beware - records sent to remote servers
reviews.text: Google has blocked this app because it “tries to access sensitive data about your account”. I have confirmed this. Data sent to a CloudFront and Firebase.

reviews.title: One of my favorites
reviews.text: This was one of my most used apps. I had it on my iPhone and iPad. One day, it stopped syncing on my iPad. So I reinstalled it. When I tried to sync it to the cloud, the app crashes. It’s been like this for months. Luckily my data is in the cloud, but it’s unusable. I’ve contacted customer support MANY times, but I never get a response.

reviews.title: Broken Promises
reviews.text:
When they switched to a subscription model years ago, Lumen Trails promised its old clients that they wouldn't have to pay the subscription because they purchased the full version. My version of the app wouldn’t let me Restore Purchase. The customer service agent said there's nothing they can do; I'd have to join new users as a subscriber. I said no to that, obviously. Proof of my purchase of the full version was found and acknowledged. Still no help. 

I kept contacting customer service over time, trying to find a solution. The girl I corresponded with who worked there responded to my understandable distress by being nasty and hateful to the point that I couldn’t use the app. My data all got deleted. 

I was one of your first users. I bought the full version. I bragged about your app, supported you, and your customer service girl treated me like trash. Shame on you for treating your customers like that. You Never made it right. You are the great story of failure of the App Store when it comes to treating your customers with fairness, professionalism, honesty, and decency
